arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'config' kind, service id, value data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'booking',booking_id,json_object('request',request_id,'flight',flight_id,'passenger',passenger_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'reference',client_reference) FROM bookings UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',charge_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step) FROM charges UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',request_id,json_object('step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'event',event_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status!='delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',hold_id,json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds

SELECT b.*, c.charge_id, c.idempotency_key, c.state AS charge_state, c.created_step, e.event_id AS cancel_event FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id WHERE b.status='pending'
